messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Undertale-style boss fight featuring Haru Urara from Umamusume, with PC arrow/Z/X/C controls and mobile joystick plus Z/X/C buttons.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained HTML5 Canvas fan battle in `index.html`, with custom pixel-style character art, menus, attacks, and touch controls.
- No external game assets or dependencies are required.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added a standalone battle game with intro, FIGHT/ACT/ITEM/MERCY choices, enemy bullet patterns, health, healing items, spare progression, win/lose states, keyboard controls, and mobile joystick/action buttons.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and captured desktop screenshots; the intro and menu rendered.

### Active
- Fix visual polish: long dialogue currently overflows the battle box; enemy HP text overlaps its bar.
- Continue browser testing of controls, battle flow, and mobile layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` around the helper functions and `drawBattleBox`; finish applying text wrapping and adjust enemy HP layout.
2. Re-run `node --check` and inspect browser console/screenshot after edits.
3. Exercise keyboard combat and mobile controls, then summarize assumptions and remaining caveats.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.
- `screenshots/desktop.png`: Captured full-page intro screenshot.
- `screenshots/menu.png`: Captured menu screenshot.

## Important Context
- A local HTTP server is running at `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright session is open.
- Current browser console errors are only missing `/favicon.ico` 404s.
- A `wrapText` helper was just added, but edits to call it inside `drawBattleBox` and adjust the enemy HP display remain unfinished.
